meta.name: hyperframes
meta.description: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建和编辑视频、动画与运动图形
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要快速生成动态视频内容
copy.tagline_en: Create and edit videos, animations, and motion graphics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce dynamic video content

howto.what: 当你有视频、动画或运动图形相关的制作需求时，Claude 会优先使用 HyperFrames 框架来处理。它会先了解你的需求，然后选择合适的制作流程，并调用相关的工具来创建或编辑视频。
howto.when: 当你提出制作、编辑或渲染视频、动画或运动图形等需求时触发，例如宣传片、解说片、字幕片段等，或者要处理现有的 HyperFrames 项目。

say.text: 帮我做一个产品宣传视频，用这个网址的内容。
给我的访谈视频添加字幕。
say.note: Claude 会使用内嵌字幕流程。

say.text: 检查一下这个 HyperFrames 项目的状态。
say.note: Claude 会检查并报告项目版本和配置。

howto.what_en: When you have a request related to making, editing, or rendering videos, animations, or motion graphics, Claude will prioritize using the HyperFrames framework. It will understand your intent, select the appropriate workflow, and invoke the needed skills to create or edit the deliverable.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to make, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic—including promos, explainers, captioned clips, etc.—or to inspect, diagnose, or validate an existing HyperFrames project.

say_en.text: Create a product launch video from this website URL.
say_en.note: Claude routes to the product-launch-video workflow.

say_en.text: Add captions to my interview footage.
Check the status of this HyperFrames project.
say_en.note: Claude runs a project check via the CLI.
